model: The most expensive thing I own is a laptop, which I bought about two years ago when I started doing freelance design work in the evenings. It cost a fortune, roughly forty million dong, which was almost three months of my salary at the time. Before that, I had an old laptop that my brother gave me, but it was so slow that it took ten minutes just to open a large file. I knew I needed a better machine, so I saved up for it for nearly a year. Even then, I didn't have enough, so I paid in instalments for the last part. It was a big decision, and I remember standing in the shop for about an hour, comparing models. In the end I decided to splash out on a top of the range model with a lot of memory and a very sharp screen, because I didn't want to buy another one in two years. My parents thought I was crazy to spend so much on a computer. But honestly, it's been a long-term investment. It runs design software without any problems, and the battery lasts all day. Thanks to it, I finished more projects, and last year my freelance income was nearly double what I spent. So I'd say the laptop has already paid off, and I don't regret it at all.
